title: mcp: the HTTP endpoint serves no resources (resources/list → Method not found) while the README documents them for the server
body:
Filing category: ① product defect (documentation and behaviour disagree on a shipped surface).
reach: public entry `/api/v1/mcp` JSON-RPC `initialize` and `resources/list`, measured once on `objectos-ee` (cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).
Batch-of: 15 cards filed together from one MCP capability test session (2026-11-11; 6 in cloud, 9 in objectstack).

## Business reason

MCP clients that browse resources (object schemas, records) find nothing over HTTP, the transport every hosted and Docker deployment uses; readers of the README expect them.

## What happens

`initialize` → `capabilities: { prompts: {}, tools: { listChanged: true } }` (no `resources`). `resources/list` → `{"code":-32601,"message":"Method not found"}`. `packages/mcp/README.md` § Resources lists `objectstack://objects`, `objectstack://objects/{objectName}`, `…/records/{recordId}`, `objectstack://metadata/types` with no transport caveat; in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` the `registerResource` calls sit on the long-lived (stdio) server only.

## Expected

Either the per-request HTTP server registers the same resources, or the README says resources are stdio-only.

Reader who acts: the seat that owns `packages/mcp`.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue mcp resources/list http` → 6 hits (#31246, #25245, #8034; stdio and refusal text), none on HTTP resources.
